Curriculum.title: Professional summary focused on product and backend engineering
Curriculum.summary: Graduate Software Engineer specialized in Full-Stack development with a focus on process automation and digitalization of document-based workflows. With experience in university, industrial and remote tech company environments, I build web and desktop systems that reduce operational times and human error. Proficient in database design, clean architectures and results-driven delivery.
Curriculum.highlight1: Web and desktop systems that digitalize physical processes with automated reporting (10 min → 1 min reduction).
Curriculum.highlight2: Relational and NoSQL database design and modeling focused on optimization and scalability.
Curriculum.highlight3: Proven experience in public university, food industry and remote tech company (Perú).

Experience.title: Experience
Experience.exp1Description: Development on the Research, Science, Technology and Innovation Observatory System. Database design corrections for better optimization, migration of physical documents into the digital system, and logic improvements bringing the system to advanced operational phases.
Experience.exp2Description: LogMaster access control and visitor management system. Requirements gathering, encrypted database design (SQLCipher/AES-256), development of desktop app (Electron + React) and web version, managerial process automation with PDF/Excel report generation. Process time reduced from 10 minutes to under 1 minute.
Experience.exp3Description: Cross-platform client development with Flutter/Dart (Android, iOS, Desktop) applying Clean Architecture and Provider for session and role management. Integration of vector animations with Rive and Glassmorphism UI design. Collaboration on full-stack with Next.js on the web layer.
